senses.d: to stop trying to do something
senses.e: Don't give up — try again tomorrow.
senses.ep: تسلیم نشو — فردا دوباره امتحان کن.

senses.d: to delay doing something to a later time
senses.e: Never put off until tomorrow what you can do today.
senses.ep: کار امروز را به فردا نینداز.

senses.e: Carry on with your work while I'm away.
senses.ep: کاری را در غیاب من ادامه بده.

senses.d: to refuse an offer or request
senses.e: She turned down the job offer.

senses.d: to take care of someone or something
senses.e: Who looks after the children while you're at work?
senses.ep: وقتی سر کار هستی چه کسی از بچه‌ها مراقبت می‌کند؟

senses.d: to have no more of something left
to meet or find something by chance
senses.e: I came across an old photo album.
senses.ep: اتفاقی یک آلبوم عکس قدیمی پیدا کردم.

senses.e: They set up a new company last year.
senses.ep: پارسال یک شرکت جدید راه‌اندازی کردند.

senses.d: to start a new hobby or activity
senses.e: He took up painting after retirement.
senses.ep: بعد از بازنشستگی نقاشی را شروع کرد.

senses.e: The car broke down on the motorway.
senses.ep: ماشین در اتوبان از کار افتاد.

senses.d: to mention a subject, or raise a child
senses.e: She brought up an interesting point.
senses.ep: او نکتهٔ جالبی را پیش کشید.

senses.e: The match was called off because of rain.
